## Merging datasets
```{r merging all, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, , results='hide'}
# categorical variables
df_list <- list(
  df__cardia_00    = df_cardia_00,
  df__cardia_10    = df_cardia_10,
  df__cardia_15    = df_cardia_15,
  df__cardia_20    = df_cardia_20,
  df__nhanes_1999  = df_nhanes_1999,
  df__nhanes_2011  = df_nhanes_2011,
  df__sol_v1       = df_sol_v1,
  df__sol_v2       = df_sol_v2
)

char_vars <- c(
  "id_study", "id", "drug_insu_db", "race", "sex", "edu_adult",
  "self_db", "drug_pill_db", "tb_treatment",
  "tb_skin_test_result", "tb_medication_use",
  "tb_history", "tb_skin_test", "self_lab_dm", "tb_dm"
)

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

df_list <- map(df_list, function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(char_vars), as.character))
})

# numeric variables
numeric_vars <- c("age_told_db", "age_told_tb")

df_list <- map(df_list, function(df) {
  
  for (var in numeric_vars) {
    if (var %in% names(df)) {
      df[[var]] <- readr::parse_number(
        as.character(df[[var]]),
        na = c("Q", "S", "", "NA")
      )
    }
  }
  
  df
})

#checking
map(df_list, ~ sapply(.[char_vars], class))

list2env(df_list, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# cleaning
rm(df_list, df_cardia_00, df_cardia_10, df_cardia_15, df_cardia_20, df_nhanes_1999,
   df_nhanes_2011, df_sol_v1, df_sol_v2)

```


```{r clean merged, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
# Merging CARDIA, NHANES, SOL

library(dplyr)

merged_data <- bind_rows(
  df__cardia_00,
  df__cardia_10,
  df__cardia_15,
  df__cardia_20,
  df__nhanes_1999,
  df__nhanes_2011,
  df__sol_v1,
  df__sol_v2
)

# checking 
table(merged_data$tb_dm) # n=137 + (updated: Y15 (3) + Y20(2))  => 142

# "Clean" dataset
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  filter(tb_dm == "Yes")          # n=142
```

```{r merged data prelim, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(gtsummary)

# Select variables to include
vars_to_summarize <- c(
  "id_study", "age", "sex", "race", "ethnicity", "edu_adult", "self_db", "age_told_db", "drug_insu_db", "drug_pill_db", "self_lab_dm", "family_hx_db",
  "tb_history", "age_told_tb", "tb_treatment", "fasting_minutes", "fglu", "hba1c", "total_cholesterol", "ldl", "weight", "height", "bmi",  "waist", "hip", "blood_pressure_sys", "blood_pressure_diast", "tb_dm")

```

```{r table merged, message=FALSE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

# Create table
merged_data_table <- merged_data %>%
  select(all_of(vars_to_summarize)) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = list(
  age_told_tb ~ "continuous",
  all_continuous() ~ "continuous"
),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%        
  as_gt() %>%
  gt::tab_header(
    title = "Summary of merged datasets"
  )

merged_data_table

```

```{r table merged unique study, message=FALSE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

# Create table
merged_data_table_unique_study <- merged_data_unique %>%
  select(all_of(vars_to_summarize)) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = id_study,  # group by studies
    type = list(
  age_told_tb ~ "continuous",
  all_continuous() ~ "continuous"
),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing = "no",
  ) %>%
  add_overall() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%        
  as_gt() %>%
  gt::tab_header(
    title = "Summary of merged datasets by Study"
  )

merged_data_table_unique_study

```
